title: Learning Transferable Visual Models From Natural Language Supervision

question_seeds.query: What training objective does CLIP use to align image and text representations?
question_seeds.expected_answer: CLIP trains image and text encoders with a contrastive objective over image-text pairs.

question_seeds.query: How does CLIP build a zero-shot image classifier from natural language prompts?
question_seeds.expected_answer: CLIP encodes class-name prompts as text embeddings and compares image embeddings against them.

question_seeds.query: What scale of image-text data is used to train CLIP?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper describes training on a large web-scale dataset of image-text pairs.

question_seeds.query: What evidence does CLIP provide for robustness to natural distribution shift?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper compares zero-shot CLIP against supervised baselines across distribution-shift benchmarks.

question_seeds.query: Which image encoder families are evaluated in CLIP?
question_seeds.expected_answer: CLIP evaluates ResNet and Vision Transformer image encoders.

title: Scaling Up Visual and Vision-Language Representation Learning With Noisy Text Supervision

question_seeds.query: How does ALIGN use noisy image-text data for vision-language representation learning?
question_seeds.expected_answer: ALIGN scales contrastive image-text learning using noisy alt-text style web data.

question_seeds.query: What encoder architecture does ALIGN use for image-text retrieval?
question_seeds.expected_answer: ALIGN uses separate image and text encoders trained into a shared embedding space.

question_seeds.query: What does ALIGN show about scaling noisy text supervision?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper reports that large-scale noisy supervision can produce strong transfer performance.

question_seeds.query: Which retrieval benchmarks are used to evaluate ALIGN?
question_seeds.expected_answer: ALIGN evaluates cross-modal retrieval on standard image-text retrieval benchmarks.

question_seeds.query: How does ALIGN evaluate zero-shot transfer?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper evaluates transfer by applying learned image-text representations without task-specific training.

title: Align before Fuse: Vision and Language Representation Learning with Momentum Distillation

question_seeds.query: What does ALBEF mean by aligning before fusing image and text features?
question_seeds.expected_answer: ALBEF first aligns unimodal image and text representations with contrastive learning before multimodal fusion.

question_seeds.query: How does ALBEF use momentum distillation to learn from noisy web data?
question_seeds.expected_answer: ALBEF uses a momentum model to generate pseudo-targets for self-training on noisy image-text pairs.

question_seeds.query: Where does cross-modal attention appear in the ALBEF architecture?
question_seeds.expected_answer: After unimodal alignment, ALBEF fuses image and text tokens through a multimodal encoder with cross-modal interaction.

question_seeds.query: Which pre-training objectives are used by ALBEF?
question_seeds.expected_answer: ALBEF combines contrastive alignment with multimodal understanding objectives such as matching and language modeling.

question_seeds.query: What evidence shows ALBEF improves image-text retrieval?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper reports image-text retrieval results showing ALBEF outperforming previous methods.

title: BLIP: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training for Unified Vision-Language Understanding and Generation

question_seeds.query: How does BLIP bootstrap captions from noisy web image-text data?
question_seeds.expected_answer: BLIP uses a captioner and filter to generate and clean synthetic captions for pre-training.

question_seeds.query: How does BLIP support both vision-language understanding and generation?
question_seeds.expected_answer: BLIP uses a unified architecture and objectives that transfer to understanding and generation tasks.

question_seeds.query: What role does the caption filter play in BLIP?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The filter removes noisy synthetic captions so the bootstrapped data is more useful.

question_seeds.query: Which downstream tasks does BLIP evaluate?
question_seeds.expected_answer: BLIP evaluates tasks such as image-text retrieval, image captioning and VQA.

question_seeds.query: What zero-shot video-language transfer result does BLIP report?
question_seeds.expected_answer: BLIP demonstrates transfer from image-language pre-training to video-language tasks.

title: Flamingo: a Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning

question_seeds.query: What role does the Perceiver Resampler play in Flamingo?
question_seeds.expected_answer: It converts variable-sized visual features into a fixed number of visual tokens for the language model.

question_seeds.query: How does Flamingo connect visual features to a frozen language model?
question_seeds.expected_answer: Flamingo inserts gated cross-attention layers into the language model while keeping major pretrained components frozen.

question_seeds.query: How does Flamingo handle interleaved images, videos and text?
question_seeds.expected_answer: Flamingo is designed to ingest sequences containing visual and textual inputs for few-shot prompting.

question_seeds.query: What evidence shows Flamingo can perform few-shot learning on vision-language tasks?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper evaluates Flamingo with few-shot prompts across VQA, captioning and related benchmarks.

question_seeds.query: What types of multimodal data are used to train Flamingo?
question_seeds.expected_answer: Flamingo trains on large-scale multimodal web corpora with text, images and videos.

title: CoCa: Contrastive Captioners are Image-Text Foundation Models

question_seeds.query: How does CoCa combine contrastive learning with captioning?
question_seeds.expected_answer: CoCa jointly optimizes contrastive image-text alignment and autoregressive captioning objectives.

question_seeds.query: How is cross-attention arranged in CoCa's decoder?
question_seeds.expected_answer: CoCa omits cross-attention in early decoder layers and uses later decoder layers for multimodal cross-attention.

question_seeds.query: What zero-shot ImageNet performance does CoCa report?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper reports strong zero-shot ImageNet classification performance for CoCa.

question_seeds.query: Which downstream task families does CoCa evaluate?
question_seeds.expected_answer: CoCa evaluates recognition, retrieval, multimodal understanding and captioning tasks.

question_seeds.query: Why does CoCa describe contrastive captioners as image-text foundation models?
question_seeds.expected_answer: Because a single pretraining setup supports both representation learning and text generation across many tasks.

title: BLIP-2: Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training with Frozen Image Encoders and Large Language Models

question_seeds.query: How does Q-Former bridge the frozen image encoder and frozen language model in BLIP-2?
question_seeds.expected_answer: Q-Former learns query embeddings that extract visual features and pass them to the frozen LLM.

question_seeds.query: What are the two stages of BLIP-2 pre-training?
question_seeds.expected_answer: BLIP-2 first learns vision-language representation with a frozen image encoder, then learns vision-to-language generation with a frozen LLM.

question_seeds.query: What are learnable query embeddings used for in Q-Former?
question_seeds.expected_answer: They interact with frozen visual features to extract a compact set of informative visual representations.

question_seeds.query: How are Q-Former outputs used as soft visual prompts for the LLM?
question_seeds.expected_answer: Projected query outputs are prepended or supplied to the LLM embedding space as visual prompts.

question_seeds.query: Which BLIP-2 table reports image-text retrieval results?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The relevant table compares BLIP-2 retrieval results on image-text retrieval benchmarks.

question_seeds.query: How does LLaVA connect the vision encoder with the language model?
question_seeds.expected_answer: LLaVA projects visual features from a CLIP vision encoder into the language embedding space with a trainable projection matrix.

question_seeds.query: How does LLaVA use GPT-4 to generate visual instruction-following data?
question_seeds.expected_answer: LLaVA prompts GPT-4 with image-related metadata to create multimodal instruction data.

question_seeds.query: What are the two training stages used by LLaVA?
question_seeds.expected_answer: LLaVA first aligns visual and language features, then performs visual instruction tuning.

question_seeds.query: How does LLaVA perform on ScienceQA with visual inputs?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper reports strong ScienceQA performance after visual instruction tuning.

question_seeds.query: What risks or broader impacts does LLaVA discuss?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper discusses risks inherited from LLMs and vision encoders as well as deployment concerns.

title: MiniGPT-4: Enhancing Vision-Language Understanding with Advanced Large Language Models

question_seeds.query: How does MiniGPT-4 align a frozen visual encoder with a frozen large language model?
question_seeds.expected_answer: MiniGPT-4 uses a projection layer to align visual features with the Vicuna language model.

question_seeds.query: Why does MiniGPT-4 use a second-stage detailed image description dataset?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The second stage improves generation quality and reduces unnatural outputs from the first stage.

question_seeds.query: What emerging multimodal capabilities does MiniGPT-4 report?
question_seeds.expected_answer: MiniGPT-4 reports abilities such as detailed image description, story writing and website generation from sketches.

question_seeds.query: Which components are frozen in MiniGPT-4 training?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The visual encoder and advanced LLM are frozen while an alignment projection is trained.

question_seeds.query: What output quality problem does MiniGPT-4 observe after the first training stage?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper observes unnatural language such as repetition or fragmented output.

title: InstructBLIP: Towards General-purpose Vision-Language Models with Instruction Tuning

question_seeds.query: What is the instruction-aware Query Transformer in InstructBLIP?
question_seeds.expected_answer: It extracts visual features conditioned on the given instruction rather than using instruction-agnostic queries.

question_seeds.query: How does InstructBLIP transform existing datasets for instruction tuning?
question_seeds.expected_answer: It converts many public vision-language datasets into instruction tuning format.

question_seeds.query: How does InstructBLIP evaluate held-in and held-out datasets?
question_seeds.expected_answer: It trains on held-in datasets and evaluates zero-shot generalization on held-out datasets.

question_seeds.query: How does InstructBLIP improve over BLIP-2?
question_seeds.expected_answer: InstructBLIP instruction-tunes BLIP-2 style models and uses instruction-aware visual feature extraction.

question_seeds.query: What ScienceQA performance does InstructBLIP report?
question_seeds.expected_answer: The paper reports strong ScienceQA accuracy when fine-tuned on individual downstream tasks.
